pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any axe. The exact axe keeps its wear and enchantments.
Starts waiting; select Chop. It works around a fixed origin with twice the common Detection Range, initially 16 blocks. Put matching saplings in its own bag before expecting it to fell a tree.

It reserves a sapling for every stump, cuts a connected natural tree, and replants. A 2×2 trunk needs four matching saplings. Reserved saplings cannot be unloaded. See $(l:fieldwork/forests)Trees and saplings$() when it stays idle.
